messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: P0 Alert: inference-serving-us-west experiencing tail-latency spikes > 3s for 95th percentile
Priya (oncall): paging now — @Dave @Katie @Emily, please ack
Dave (infra): acked. jumping in, grabbing logs from the serving cluster
Katie (SRE): acked. will spin up a quick tracer and check loadbalancer metrics
Priya (oncall): creating war room: https://zoom.company/w/abc123 — joining
Scribe-Bot: Scribe assigned: Priya will scribe the first 15m, then handoff to Katie
Dave (infra): running:
```
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=redwood-serving --tail=200 | grep -i "latency"
```
Dave (infra): seeing repeated `kvcache` timeouts and a bunch of 504s to model-backend-2
Katie (SRE): scaling up model-backend-2 pool by +2 instances now
Priya (oncall): owner -> Dave (infra), secondary -> Katie (sre)
Emily (Product): product — customer impact? which customers hit?
Dave (infra): preliminary: small subset of bursty enterprise tenants in us-west, ~12% of requests failing
Priya (oncall): drafting status update for status.redwood.ai — proposing:
"We are investigating increased inference latency and intermittent errors in US-WEST. A mitigation is in progress; some customers may experience degraded response times. We will provide updates every 15 minutes."
Emily (Product): tweak: add "enterprise customers on bursty workloads may see errors" and link support doc
Priya (oncall): ok. final draft:
"We are investigating increased inference latency and intermittent errors affecting a subset of enterprise customers in US-WEST. Engineers have identified load-related timeouts to a model backend and are deploying mitigations. We will post updates every 15 minutes."
Scribe-Bot: Status update posted to status.redwood.ai/incidents/4420001234
Katie (SRE): mitigation deployed, routing adjusted to avoid model-backend-2 for new requests — monitoring
Dave (infra): tail latency improving to ~1.1s 95p
Priya (oncall): good. schedule handoff at +45m to oncall-next (Katie) — I'll stay for handoff
Emily (Product): preparing customer notification draft for support to send (to be reviewed)
Priya (oncall): call out to @support: hold on sending notices until we confirm error rates <2% and latency stable
Support-Bot: acknowledged. awaiting go/no-go
Dave (infra): adding a quick debug snippet to the war room notes:
```
curl -sS http://model-backend-2.local/health || echo "backend unhealthy"
```
Katie (SRE): scribe takeover in 15m
Priya (oncall): thanks team. continuing to monitor, next update in 15m :thumbsup:
